title: Arrival + light Shinjuku
note: Keep this day deliberately light after immigration, transfer, and hotel check-in.

stops.name: Tokyo arrival + hotel check-in
stops.transport: Airport transfer to Tokyo hotel · To be confirmed
stops.photoTip: Save a first-night city view for later.
stops.notes: Do not pre-book a rigid attraction on arrival day.

stops.name: Shinjuku light sightseeing + dinner
stops.photoTip: Use the east exit skyline and side streets.
stops.notes: Return early if jet lagged.

title: Asakusa + ENNE Ring Workshop
note: Everything is walkable once you reach Asakusa. Keep the workshop time flexible until booked.

stops.name: Kaminarimon Gate + Senso-ji Temple + Nakamise Street
stops.photoTip: Shoot Kaminarimon before the shopping street fills.
stops.notes: Breakfast near Asakusa, then temple and shopping street.

stops.name: ENNE RING Asakusa · Vintage Coin Ring Workshop
stops.station: Asakusa / Tawaramachi area · confirm with provider
stops.photoTip: Photograph the coin before and after shaping.
stops.notes: Confirm exact address, slot, price and cancellation policy with ENNE RING.

stops.name: Sumida River walk + Asakusa dinner
stops.photoTip: Use the riverbank for Tokyo Skytree views.
stops.notes: Leave time for workshop delays and browsing.

title: Ginza craft + Marunouchi + Harajuku / Shibuya
note: This is a full Tokyo day, but workable because the Ginza workshop is only around one hour. Keep shopping intentional.

stops.name: Chopsticks Studio Ginza · Traditional Chopstick Making
stops.photoTip: Photograph wood selection and finished pair.
stops.notes: Confirm the exact studio, address, slot, price and availability.

stops.name: Ginza + Tokyo Station + Marunouchi
stops.photoTip: Use Tokyo Station Marunouchi facade from KITTE terrace.
stops.notes: Include a proper lunch and shopping buffer.

stops.name: Harajuku + Shibuya + Marunouchi Christmas Illuminations
stops.transport: JR Yamanote Line; return to Tokyo Station for lights
stops.photoTip: Use Omotesando lights and Marunouchi tree-lined avenues.
stops.notes: This is the densest day. Drop Harajuku first if workshop timing runs late.

title: Mt. Omuro + Izu Cactus Park + Jogasaki Coast Tour
leaveBy: Tour departure around 07:00 · To be confirmed
note: Do not add major Tokyo attractions. This is a full-day tour with a late Tokyo return.

stops.name: Mt. Omuro / Izu Cactus Park / Jogasaki Coast full-day tour
stops.station: Tokyo departure point · confirm with tour operator
stops.photoTip: Use a wide lens at Jogasaki and keep a wind layer for Mt. Omuro.
stops.notes: Schedule is based on the listed tour; confirm meeting point, inclusions and seasonal operation before booking.

stops.name: Tokyo hotel rest + simple dinner
stops.photoTip: Skip pressure to photograph; this is recovery time.
stops.notes: Pack for Kyoto after dinner.

title: Shinkansen + Nagoya Castle + Higashiyama evening
note: This is now a full transfer day. Send luggage ahead and keep the Kyoto portion flexible; do not attempt extra shopping in Nagoya.

stops.name: Tokyo hotel → Nagoya by Shinkansen
stops.duration: Approx. 1 hr 40 min on the fastest services
stops.travelTime: Approx. 1 hr 40 min plus station buffers
stops.photoTip: Choose a window seat only if you want to photograph the route; keep bags manageable.
stops.notes: Reserve seats and oversized baggage space if needed. Confirm the exact train before travel.

stops.name: Nagoya Castle + local lunch
stops.price: Admission and lunch · To be confirmed
stops.transport: Nagoya Station → subway to Nagoyajo Station on the Meijo Line, then walk
stops.photoTip: Use the moat and the Hommaru Palace exterior for a wider castle frame.
stops.notes: Leave Nagoya early enough for Kyoto. Castle entry hours and the keep access must be confirmed before travel.

stops.name: Nagoya → Kyoto by Shinkansen
stops.duration: Approx. 35–40 min on the fastest services
stops.photoTip: No dedicated photo stop; prioritise arriving before Kyoto sights close.
stops.notes: Go directly to hotel luggage storage or Higashiyama. Confirm the exact train before travel.

stops.name: Kiyomizu-dera + Ninenzaka + Sannenzaka, then Gion + Yasaka Shrine
stops.price: Kiyomizu admission and dinner · To be confirmed
stops.transport: Taxi or Kyoto bus from Kyoto Station, then walk through Higashiyama
stops.bestTime: Arrive before the confirmed temple entry cut-off; Gion after sunset
stops.photoTip: Photograph Ninenzaka before dusk and use side streets in Gion.
stops.notes: This is tight after Nagoya. If the Nagoya stop runs late, skip Kiyomizu and enjoy Gion/Yasaka only; do not rush both.

title: Arashiyama + Fushimi Inari + Nara Deer Tour
note: This is the only main-itinerary appearance of Arashiyama, Fushimi Inari and Nara Park.

stops.name: Arashiyama + Fushimi Inari + Nara Deer day tour
stops.station: Kyoto departure point · confirm with operator
stops.photoTip: Arashiyama early; keep a wider frame at Fushimi Inari and Nara Park.
stops.notes: Confirm tour order, meeting point, inclusions, Nara Park time and return time before booking.

stops.name: Kyoto hotel rest + nearby dinner
stops.photoTip: No major photos required.
stops.notes: Keep this unplanned for fatigue, laundry or a quiet dinner.

title: Osaka day trip · Kimono, Castle, Namba + Dotonbori
note: Stay in Kyoto. Osaka is a day trip, then return at night. Do not move hotels.

stops.name: Kyoto → Osaka + Kimono Rental Misaki fitting
stops.transport: JR Special Rapid / Hankyu / Keihan route based on provider address
stops.travelTime: Approx. 30–60 min Kyoto to central Osaka, plus provider transfer
stops.photoTip: Confirm whether photos are included and where changing is permitted.
stops.notes: Provider location, booking link, rental return deadline and photo-shoot scope must be confirmed.

stops.name: Osaka Castle photos + Osaka sightseeing
stops.transport: Osaka Metro / JR from rental location
stops.photoTip: Use the castle moat and outer grounds; check kimono return time before travelling far.
stops.notes: Keep lunch and travel buffer; castle interior is optional.

stops.name: Namba + Dotonbori dinner / street food + return to Kyoto
stops.transport: Osaka Metro to Namba, then rail to Kyoto
stops.travelTime: Approx. 40–60 min to Kyoto after Namba, route dependent
stops.photoTip: Shoot canal reflections rather than blocking the Glico sign crowd.
stops.notes: Optional only: teamLab Botanical Garden Osaka if rental return timing, energy, weather and opening hours allow. Return to Kyoto at night.

title: Departure + airport transportation
leaveBy: Departure time depends on flight · confirm before travel
note: Keep this day clear. For a Narita departure, plan Kyoto Station → Shinkansen to Tokyo → Narita Express, with a large airport buffer.

stops.name: Hotel check-out + Kyoto Station
stops.photoTip: Keep passport, phone and tickets in one accessible pouch.
stops.notes: Confirm hotel luggage storage and check-out time.

stops.name: Kyoto → Tokyo → Narita International Airport
stops.station: Kyoto Station → Tokyo Station → Narita Airport
stops.travelTime: 2 hr 15 min Shinkansen plus Narita Express and transfer buffers
stops.photoTip: No sightseeing planned.
stops.notes: Confirm airline terminal, train reservations and airport arrival target before departure.

stops.name: Flight departure
stops.photoTip: Save your final Japan photo before security.
stops.notes: Flight details and terminal to be confirmed.
